content.class.carrier.blurb: 别人没法回来取的东西，你去搬运。安塞尔的信把你带到了索尔特洛。
content.class.carrier.kit.0.name: 安塞尔的信
content.class.carrier.kit.1.name: 搬运者的提灯
content.class.carrier.name: 搬运者
content.containers.decoration_notice: 秋天，索尔特洛迁往内陆，把能搬的都搬走了。如今桶和箱子都空着，只有特意留下的东西还在原地。
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-errand.opt.0.label: 我们去取。
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-errand.opt.1.label: 哪栋房子？
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-errand.text: 那好，是这么个活儿。我妹妹玛拉跟其他人一起去了内陆。她给我留了一个包裹，在她床脚的箱子里。我这会儿离不开船，潮水不等人。取回来，我就送你们过去。
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-hello.opt.0.label: 收到你的信。
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-hello.opt.1.label: 人都去哪儿了？
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-hello.opt.2.label: 哪栋房子来着？
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-hello.text: 搬运者，是吧？好。我还以为没人看信了。
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-return.opt.0.label: 包裹在这儿。
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-thanks.opt.0.label: 走吧。
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-thanks.text: 就是它。上面是她的绳结。好。上船，当心船舷。潮水不等任何人，这儿也没人可等了。
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-town.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-town.text: 去了内陆。鲱鱼两个冬天前离开了，再没回来。秋天他们把索尔特洛所有的大车都装满，走了。现在我不爱走那条街。那些房子有一半是我从小住到大的。
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-which-house.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.ansel.ansel-which-house.text: 街北边最后一栋，靠码头最近。箱子在她床脚。那条街上别的东西都装上大车了。
content.loot.the-last-firing.item.2.name: 烟熏鳕鱼
content.npc.ansel.name: 安塞尔·塔罗
content.obj.the-parcel.fetch-the-parcel.hint: 玛拉的房子在街北边最后一栋，靠码头最近。箱子在她床脚。
content.obj.the-parcel.fetch-the-parcel.title: 取回玛拉的包裹
content.obj.the-parcel.hand-it-over.hint: 带着包裹沿街返回，交给码头上的安塞尔。
content.obj.the-parcel.hand-it-over.title: 把包裹交给安塞尔
content.obj.the-parcel.meet-ansel.hint: 沿街走到尽头，那个男人在码头上等着。
content.obj.the-parcel.meet-ansel.title: 找到摆渡人
content.quest.the-parcel.goal: 沿着索尔特洛空无一人的街道走到渡口，取回玛拉·塔罗留在家中给哥哥的包裹，在潮水转向之前送到码头交给他。
content.world.outro: 渡船驶离索尔特洛。街上空无一人，没人看着它离开。
content.world.title: 空壳镇

source.class.carrier.blurb: You carry what other people cannot come back for. Ansel's letter brought you to Saltlow.
source.class.carrier.kit.0.name: Ansel's letter
source.class.carrier.kit.1.name: Carrier's lantern
source.class.carrier.name: Carrier
source.containers.decoration_notice: Saltlow went inland in the autumn and took everything that would carry. Its barrels and chests stand empty now; only what was left on purpose is still here.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-errand.opt.0.label: We'll fetch it.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-errand.opt.1.label: Which house?
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-errand.text: Then here's the job. My sister Marra went inland with the rest. She left one parcel for me, in the chest at the foot of her bed, and I can't leave the boat on this tide. Fetch it, and I'll take you across.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-hello.opt.0.label: We got your letter.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-hello.opt.1.label: Where is everyone?
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-hello.opt.2.label: Which house again?
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-hello.text: Carriers, are you? Good. I'd begun to think nobody read letters any more.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-return.opt.0.label: Here's the parcel.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-return.text: Is that it? Let me see.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-thanks.opt.0.label: Let's go.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-thanks.text: That's it. That's her knot on it. Right. Get in, and mind the gunwale. The tide won't wait for anyone, and there's nobody left to wait for.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-town.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-town.text: Inland. The herring moved off two winters back and didn't come again. In the autumn they loaded every cart in Saltlow and went. I don't like walking that street now. I grew up in half those houses.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-which-house.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.ansel.ansel-which-house.text: The last one on the north side, nearest the quay. The chest at the foot of her bed. Everything else in that street went in the carts.
source.loot.the-last-firing.item.2.name: Smoked cod
source.npc.ansel.name: Ansel Tarrow
source.obj.the-parcel.fetch-the-parcel.hint: Marra's house is the last on the north side of the street, nearest the quay. The chest is at the foot of her bed.
source.obj.the-parcel.fetch-the-parcel.title: Fetch Marra's parcel
source.obj.the-parcel.hand-it-over.hint: Take the parcel back down the street to Ansel on the quay.
source.obj.the-parcel.hand-it-over.title: Bring the parcel to Ansel
source.obj.the-parcel.meet-ansel.hint: Walk down the street to the man waiting on the quay at the far end.
source.obj.the-parcel.meet-ansel.title: Find the ferryman
source.quest.the-parcel.goal: Walk down Saltlow's empty street to the ferry, fetch the parcel Marra Tarrow left in her house for her brother, and bring it to him at the quay before the tide turns.
source.world.outro: The ferry pulls away from Saltlow. Nobody is left on the street to watch it go.
source.world.title: The Stripped Town
